profile.headline: Web Designer & Front-End Developer
profile.summary: Expert in digital design with Adobe Suite and AI, along with modern front-end technologies like Tailwind CSS, React, jQuery, and more.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: My primary responsibilities include working on internal tools, and serving as the webmaster for Inked. This involves maintaining and enhancing the website's functionality, user experience, and overall performance.

positions.title: Web Designer/Front-End Developer
positions.description:
– Managed web development tasks, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and live deployments, using tools like Visual Studio and version control systems.
– Routinely updated designs, merchandise, site layout/structure, and the online catalogs to align with current sales and customer engagement goals.
– Lead the redesign and optimization of key web pages, significantly elevating user experience and boosting the site's performance metrics.
– Championed data-driven design through advanced analytics and user behavior insights, resulting in informed enhancements and a substantial improvement in website accessibility standards.
– Innovated by using Adobe Creative Suite's AI in digital asset production, which significantly increased the efficiency of certain tasks and opened up possibilities for certain designs
– Utilized Adobe Photoshop for high volume photo editing involving things like color correcting, package reskins, and touch ups.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · jQuery · HTML/CSS · Adobe Suite · Bootstrap (Framework) · ASP.NET · Visual Studio · Version Control Tools · WordPress · Google Analytics · GitHub · Klaviyo · Hotjar · BrowserStack

positions.title: Web Developer/Designer
positions.description:
– Redesigned and transitioned the client’s online presence from WordPress to Shopify
– Lead the design and development process, ensuring the project aligned with sales goals and client specifications
– Customized functionality and aesthetics using a mix of Shopify’s Liquid templating language, custom HTML/CSS, Javascript, and third party applications
– Trained client and other staff on how to use the Shopify platform, enabling things like effective product price updates, and fostering eventual client autonomy.
– Provided comprehensive website maintenance and support, promptly resolving issues to ensure uninterrupted online operations and customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Web Development · Wordpress Development · Shopify · JavaScript · HTML/CSS · Adobe Creative Suite

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
– Designed flyers, posctcards, offering memorandums, and other print/marketing materials for commercial real estate properties, realtors, and events
– Collaborated with realtors, project managers, other designers, and other departments to achieve a successful end product
– Created websites advertising commercial properties, and specific teams/offices
positions.insights: Skills: Graphic Design · Adobe InDesign · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Premiere Pro · After Effects

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Created a brand identity for the company (logo, website, brand guide)
- Edited videos in Adobe Premier and Adobe After Effects
- Communicated with clients regarding shot-lists and highlighted information
- Operated drone
positions.insights: Skills: HTML/CSS · JavaScript · Bootstrap (Framework) · WordPress · Adobe Suite

positions.title: Graphic Designer/Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
- Created new graphic, web and print assets for marketing
- Redesigned the company logo
- Managed marketing projects involving third party contractors 
- Collaborated with other departments, realtors, and the company owner
- Created videos to advertise commercial properties 
- Managed the company website via the Wordpress platform
- Rapidly completed Offering Memorandums
positions.insights: Skills: HTML/CSS · JavaScript · WordPress · Adobe Suite
